source_references.notes: Browser red-spot weighted centroid with a documented data dictionary and proposed validation protocol.
Related weighted red centroid and peak-to-peak window aggregation with explicit physics and validation limits.

known_boundaries: The direct observation is an image-space light-spot centroid in pixels, not mechanical displacement or amplitude.
Version 0.4.0 intentionally supports the source red-channel profile only.
Synthetic replay and source compatibility do not establish real-experiment metrology, repeatability, or uncertainty.
